versions.content: Service Name Csm_JobKeyWrap Syntax Std_ReturnType Csm_JobKeyWrap ( uint32 jobId, uint32 sourceKeyId, uint8* ciphertextPtr, uint32* ciphertextLengthPtr, uint8* authenticatorPtr, uint32* authenticatorLengthPtr ) Service ID [hex] 0x89 Sync/Async Depends on configuration Reentrancy Reentrant jobId Holds the identifier of the job using the CSM service. Parameters (in) sourceKeyId Holds the identifier of the key to be wrapped. ciphertextLengthPtr Contains the length in bytes of the wrapped key. Parameters (inout) authenticatorLengthPtr Contains the length in bytes of the authenticator. ciphertextPtr References the data of the wrapped key. Parameters (out) authenticatorPtr References the data of the authenticator. ▽ △ Return value Std_ReturnType E_OK: Request successful E_NOT_OK: Request failed CRYPTO_E_BUSY: Request failed, service is still busy CRYPTO_E_KEY_READ_FAIL: Request failed, not allowed to extract key element CRYPTO_E_KEY_NOT_VALID: Request failed, the key’s state is "invalid" CRYPTO_E_KEY_SIZE_MISMATCH: Request failed, key element sizes are not compatible CRYPTO_E_KEY_EMPTY: Request failed because of uninitialized source key element CRYPTO_E_JOB_CANCELED: Request failed because the job has been canceled. Description Wraps the plaintext key given by sourceKeyId (in the key element with the id 1) with the key wrapping key associated with the jobId. The wrapped key will be written to ciphertextPtr. If the algorithm does provide an authenticator this will be written to authenticatorPtr. If the algorithm has no authenticator or the algorithm has an authenticator and no authentication shall be done, authenticatorLengthPtr shall be set to zero. Available via Csm.h
